protocol_clarifications.normal_condition: The condition named normal is a routine mixed-observation condition: 2.5 percent independent missingness, plus a 30-frame or hit-centered30-frame gap on25 percent of paths/views. It does not mean perfect observations. Geometric out-of-view frames remain missing in every condition.
protocol_clarifications.paired_appearance: Physical paths, central cameras and base missing masks are shared. Appearance-only and combined augmentations use the same parameter distributions but not identical realized exposure/shape draws because the observation intervention consumes an earlier part of the seeded random stream. This is a matched-distribution comparison, not an exactly coupled appearance-by-observation factorial.
protocol_clarifications.legacy_control: Legacy uses the historical appearance/observation family through the corrected common input contract on the same real-camera template distribution as the other arms. It is not a replay of the original2.6M training distribution.
protocol_clarifications.camera_candidates: Two fixed local camera perturbations around the central estimate are used as a sensitivity ensemble. They are not samples from a verified camera posterior and not a demonstrated calibrated credible set. Court-only fit information is used where available; real calibration truth is absent.
protocol_clarifications.new_real_scope: Twelve previously unused public excerpts, ten approximately fixed-camera and two uncertain/moving. Source identity was visually screened, but complete match provenance and detector pretraining disjointness are not certified. They cannot establish complete uncut-rally accuracy.
protocol_clarifications.selection: All selection remains synthetic-dev-only. These clarifications change no sources, data, update schedule, seeds or model-selection rules.
